title: fumana laevis subsp. juniperina
intro: Fumana laevis subsp. juniperina, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a plant species belonging to the Cistaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help in soothing skin irritations and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose include calming the nervous system, reducing anxiety and stress, and promoting a restful sleep. The bioactive constituents of Rock Rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
